column7: SetDynamicSecretConfigEnabled had no parent-liveness check, so a dynamic-secret config could be re-enabled while its project was soft-deleted — invisible in every project-scoped view, and live again the moment someone restored the project, with no re-authorization at that point (#369/#370 restore-reactivation class). Enabling now requires a live project via the soft-delete-scoped GetProject; disabling stays ungated (the safe direction). Found by GUARD-5 ordering sweep under a SERIAL ordering, so not a race: distinct from #2651, whose racing path #2675 fixes separately.
